ideas.pitch: A mentorship and opportunity matching platform pairing underrepresented womeyn in STEM with London-based tech companies for micro-internships.
ideas.title: STEMConnect London
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the core mission of an inclusivity-focused hackathon, making it appealing to judges looking for social impact and community value.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered career pathway tracker and skills gap analyzer specifically tailored for women entering biotech and engineering fields in the UK.
ideas.title: BioTrack STEM
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a practical tool for career development with actionable data analytics, scoring well on utility and empowerment themes.

ideas.pitch: A community-driven safety routing and companion app for women working late in London tech hubs and universities.
ideas.title: SafePath STEM London
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses an immediate local safety pain point for London-based attendees and participants, creating high emotional resonance with judges.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized grant and pitch matching portal for women-led technical startups seeking early-stage angel syndicates in London.
ideas.title: InnoFundHer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on economic empowerment and entrepreneurship, directly supporting the broader goals of women in STEM initiatives.

ideas.pitch: A peer-to-peer equipment and research asset sharing marketplace for female researchers and independent labs across London universities.
ideas.title: LabShare UK
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a tangible resource allocation problem for academic and corporate researchers with a clear operational workflow.
